cases.description: Passing a null algorithm string should throw IllegalArgumentException with message "Null algorithm".

group: Java algorithm name without hyphen (no length)

cases.description: Java style name without hyphen matches the regex; it is converted to "hmac-sha256." and returned (map contains this key).

group: Java algorithm name with truncated length

cases.description: Java style name with "/128" matches the regex; conversion adds the length suffix, resulting in "hmac-sha256-128.".
String without hyphen does not match the regex; after appending a dot it is not present in algMap, causing an IllegalArgumentException.
Input already contains a hyphen, so regex handling is skipped; a trailing dot is added and the name is looked up in algMap.
Input already ends with a dot; no extra dot is appended and the name is resolved via algMap.
The alias "hmac-md5" (or "hmac-md5.") is mapped directly to the constant HMAC_MD5, bypassing the algMap lookup.
Name.fromString throws TextParseException for an illegal DNS name; the method catches it and re‑throws IllegalArgumentException wrapping the original exception.
Pattern matching is case‑insensitive; "HMACSHA1" is recognized and converted to "hmac-sha1.".

group: Lowercase Java algorithm name without hyphen

cases.description: Java style name in all lower‑case matches the regex (case‑insensitive) and is converted to the RFC form "hmac-sha256." which exists in algMap.

group: Java algorithm name with unsupported truncated length

cases.description: The pattern matches the base algorithm but captures a three‑digit length "256" that is not present in algMap, causing an IllegalArgumentException after the lookup.

group: Hyphenated algorithm name with unsupported length suffix

cases.description: Because the input already contains a hyphen the regex is skipped; after appending a trailing dot the name "hmac-sha256-128." is not in algMap, leading to an IllegalArgumentException.

group: Alias for MD5 with trailing dot

cases.description: The method treats "hmac-md5" (with or without a trailing dot) as a special alias and returns the constant HMAC_MD5.
Whitespace is not trimmed by Name.fromString; parsing fails and the caught TextParseException is wrapped in an IllegalArgumentException.

group: Algorithm name with double dot suffix

cases.description: A name ending with two dots is syntactically invalid; Name.fromString throws TextParseException which is re‑thrown as IllegalArgumentException.

group: Java algorithm name with non‑numeric length suffix

cases.description: The regex matches the base algorithm but captures a non‑numeric length; after conversion the resulting name is not present in algMap, causing an IllegalArgumentException.
Input already contains a hyphen, so regex handling is skipped; DNS names are case‑insensitive, thus "HMAC-SHA384" resolves to the same Name as "hmac-sha384." which exists in algMap.
A hyphenated name that is syntactically valid but not present in algMap should trigger an IllegalArgumentException indicating the unknown algorithm.
An empty string is converted to a single dot, which is a valid DNS name but not present in algMap, resulting in an IllegalArgumentException indicating an unknown algorithm.
A single dot represents the DNS root name; it parses successfully but is not mapped in algMap, causing an IllegalArgumentException for an unknown algorithm.
A string consisting only of a hyphen is not a valid DNS label; Name.fromString throws TextParseException which is wrapped in IllegalArgumentException.
A name ending with a hyphen ("hmac-") is syntactically invalid for DNS; parsing fails and the method re‑throws IllegalArgumentException wrapping the TextParseException.

The input contains a slash, which is illegal in DNS labels; because the string already contains a hyphen the regex is skipped and Name.fromString throws TextParseException, wrapped in IllegalArgumentException.
The '$' character is not allowed in DNS names; parsing fails and the method re‑throws IllegalArgumentException containing the original TextParseException.

group: Java algorithm with unsupported SHA number

cases.description: The Java‑style name matches the regex, is converted to "hmac-sha999.", but this algorithm is not present in algMap, leading to an IllegalArgumentException indicating an unknown algorithm.
